messages:
Ava (Marketing): Quick kickoff: targeting public launch Wed 2026-04-01 10:00 PT. Need final changelog blurb, docs URL, and webinar RSVP. Also want a short benchmark callout for the announcement hero.
Jon (Eng): Can confirm timeline. Which model variant are we naming in the post? We used rwd-infer-v2-medium in canary. Any embargo constraints?
Ava (Marketing): Use rwd-infer-v2-medium. Embargo lift = 2026-04-01 10:00 PT. Changelog draft: https://internal.redwood/changelog/PR-410. Please post the final one-line and two bullets for the blog.
Priya (Docs): I'll prep /docs/release-2026-04-01 and add an anchor: /docs/release-2026-04-01#launch-notes. Will include migration note for routing config. ETA tomorrow morning.
Nora (Growth): Working RSVP (staging): https://events.redwood.ai/launch?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=apr_launch. I can update to prod once docs live. Need speaker line and short CTA.
Jon (Eng): Perf highlights from bench: gen p50 68ms -> was 85ms, p95 290ms -> was 380ms. Token cost down ~10% after routing change. CSV available. Is that OK for "~20% improvement" claim?
Ava (Marketing): We'll phrase it conservatively: "up to ~20% latency improvement on common prompts and lower per-token compute cost." Can eng sign off on that wording?
Jon (Eng): That's fine. Recommend rollout: 5% T+0, 25% T+20m, 60% T+1h, 100% T+3h. Ops should set health gates.
Luca (Ops): OK on ramp. Rollback thresholds: >1.5% 5min errors OR sustained p50 >2x baseline for 10m. I'll add playbook. Contact list in runbook: oncall, eng lead, marketing lead.
Ava (Marketing): Changelog one-liner draft: "Routing and KV-cache improvements to speed up hosted inference and reduce per-token costs." Blog bullets: "Smarter request routing lowers average token latency by up to ~20%" and "KV-cache fixes improve cold-start tail latency and reduce compute spend."
Priya (Docs): I'll add those bullets and a short upgrade note: "No customer changes required; optional routing flags available for Dedicated users."
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 5% -> 1767779588 (T+12m), 25% -> 1767780788 (T+38m), 60% -> 1767784388 (T+1.5h), 100% -> 1767788488 (T+3.5h). Healthchecks enabled. :robot_face:
Nora (Growth): Speaker blurb: "Join our engineers to see live demos of faster inference and new routing controls." CTA: "Register to save your seat — limited spots."
Luca (Ops): We'll post canary metrics to #eng-sre. If thresholds met, we'll tag this thread and trigger incident runbook.
Jon (Eng): Please include exact model and quantization/precision details in the blog (we ran bf16, no quantization). I'll update the changelog PR by EOD with the final wording.
Ava (Marketing): Thanks. Nora will swap RSVP to final doc link when Priya publishes. Tagging @Jon @Priya @Luca. If anything changes, update this thread. :thumbsup:
